title: At the pharmacy
listen_for: What is wrong with Tom, and what does the pharmacist tell him to do?

sentences.speaker: lena
sentences.text: Hello! How can I help you today?

sentences.speaker: tom
sentences.text: Hi. I have a bad cough and a sore throat.

sentences.speaker: lena
sentences.text: I'm sorry to hear that. How long have you had it?

sentences.speaker: tom
sentences.text: About three days. I also have a small fever.

sentences.speaker: lena
sentences.text: Do you have any allergies to medicine?

sentences.speaker: tom
sentences.text: Yes, I am allergic to penicillin.

sentences.speaker: lena
sentences.text: Thank you for telling me. This cough syrup is safe for you.

sentences.speaker: tom
sentences.text: Great. How often should I take it?

sentences.speaker: lena
sentences.text: Take one spoonful in the morning and one at night.

sentences.speaker: tom
sentences.text: Good. Do I need anything else?

sentences.speaker: lena
sentences.text: Drink warm water with honey, and rest at home for two days.

sentences.speaker: tom
sentences.text: Thank you. How much is it?

sentences.speaker: tom
sentences.text: Here you are. Have a nice day!

key.explanation: When Lena asks about allergies, Tom says he is allergic to penicillin.

spoken.prompt: In your own words, what is wrong with Tom, and what does the pharmacist tell him to do?

Tom says he has a cough

sequence_key.explanation: Tom describes his cough first, then Lena asks about allergies, explains the syrup, and Tom pays last.
